moments.name: Failure Will (NOT) Be Tolerated
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: revive at 150% max HP (heal fully, then max HP x1.5 for the battle), gain Overcharged for the rest of the battle. Overcharged: every move has a 1-turn cooldown (cannot be used two turns in a row), all five stats x2. Ends when the battle ends. One claim per run, win or lose the roll.
moments.presentation: Screen fades to black, static + electrical crackle 1.2 s, robotic voice reads 4 lines (see catalog notes), electric flare, Overcharged theme loop while active | stand-in voice + theme | "Primary Goal: Protect father. Failed."

moments.name: The Grave Refuses
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, max HP x1.5, moves x1.75, immune to status conditions. Cost: loses 1/10 of its max HP each turn and can't be healed by anything. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A funeral bell far away, whispers; an old, dry voice | "Another one comes to the gate."

lines: "I know this one. It has someone waiting."
scene.rise: The battlefield returns, colder and grey. [Name] stands up slowly, as if it's being pulled up by strings.

moments.name: The Old Blood
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, max HP x1.25, Attack and Sp. Atk x1.75, can't flinch. Cost: it uses its highest-damage move every turn. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Two heartbeats, one huge; old letters burn onto the black as a deep cave voice reads them | "Before your kind walked, we flew."

lines: "We do not end on a road."
scene.rise: A roar shakes the screen. [Name] rises in red light.

moments.name: Nature Reclaims
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Defence and Sp. Def x2, restores 1/8 HP each turn. Cost: Speed x0.5 and it can't switch out. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Roots crack through the black, slowed birdsong; many voices at once, like wind through leaves | "You walked through us. You did not cut us down."

lines: "You walked through us. You did not cut us down."
"The forest remembers who passed through gently."
scene.rise: Vines lift [Name] back up. Moss covers its wounds.

moments.name: The Pack Doesn't Leave Its Own
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Speed x2, Attack x1.5, the foe's Attack drops each turn. Cost: it takes 1.25x damage. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Silence, then howls getting closer; no voice, the lines appear one per howl | A pack does not leave its own.

lines: A pack does not leave its own.
scene.rise: [Name] gets up in the dark, eyes bright.

remembers.add: The whole pack howls. Another pair of eyes opens in the dark first.

moments.name: The Contract
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, every stat x1.75. Cost: the Collector takes 10% of this battle's prize money. Nothing else. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A pen scratching on paper; a smooth, polite salesman's voice | "Ah. There you are."

lines: "Do you remember our agreement? You fed me. You kept me. You didn't trade me away."
"Fee: a small one. I'll collect it later."
scene.rise: A signature flares in purple fire across the screen. [Name] stands up, grinning.

moments.name: Critical Mass
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, every stat x2.5. Cost: a countdown from 5; at 0 it uses Explosion. If that downs the last foe you win, if not the run ends. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A rising whine like a generator; a flat, automatic alarm voice | "Core temperature: critical."

scene.rise: White light. [Name] is back, glowing too brightly to look at. The countdown starts: 5.

moments.name: Ascension
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def x2, immune to Ground moves and contact moves. Cost: it can't use physical moves. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: The screen fades to white, a long high tone; a soft, clear voice inside the head | "My body stopped."

lines: "I let go of the body. I didn't let go of you."
scene.rise: [Name] floats up from where it fell, outlined in light, with its eyes closed.

moments.name: The Oath
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Attack x2, can't fall below 1 HP for 3 turns. Cost: at the end of the third turn, if the battle isn't won, it faints. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Steel sliding from a sheath; its own voice, low and steady | "I swore to stand in front of you."

lines: "I swore to stand in front of you."
scene.rise: [Name] rises on one knee, then two feet, and raises its blade toward the opponent.

remembers.add: It remembers the glove on the ground. It stands like it did then.
The leek is bent. It doesn't care.

moments.name: Hive Mind
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, three bodies, each hit removes one whatever the damage; its moves hit twice at 60%. Cost: it can't Protect, and when the last body falls it faints. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Buzzing from everywhere; hundreds of tiny voices, slightly out of sync | "ONE FELL."

scene.rise: [Name] reforms out of a cloud of smaller copies of itself. Three outlines.

moments.name: The Deep
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Defence x2, Water moves x1.5, an attacker that hits it loses 1 Speed. Cost: Speed x0.5. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Deep blue, then black; sonar and slow whale song; a calm dive-computer voice | "Depth: two hundred metres. Light: fading."

scene.rise: Bubbles rise. [Name] comes up from below the battlefield with the water.

moments.name: Thrown Away
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, max HP x1.5, an attacker that hits it loses 1 from its highest stat. Cost: its own moves x0.75. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A music box winds down and stops; a cracked, quiet toy voice | "Somebody threw me out once."

lines: "I waited by the bins for a long time."
"Nobody throws you out. Not while I'm here."
scene.rise: The music box starts again, wound by something unseen. [Name] stands, patched and stitched.

moments.name: Primal Awakening
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Protosynthesis doubled, on its two best stats, sun or not; max HP x1.25. Cost: it can't switch and loses 1/16 HP each turn. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A cave painting draws itself across the black; a growl the subtitles translate | [Before the cities.]

scene.rise: A roar. [Name] rises, the ground around it cracked like old earth.

moments.name: Supernova
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, sun for 5 turns, Fire moves x2, every Pokémon on the field loses 1/16 HP a turn. Cost: it loses the 1/16 too. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: A heavy, low hum getting brighter; a calm, enormous readout voice | "Fuel: spent."

scene.rise: The screen goes white-hot, then the battlefield returns under a gold sky. [Name] is burning.

moments.name: Absolute Zero
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, Ice moves have a 30% freeze chance, Defence x2, hail for 5 turns. Cost: after its first move it can act only every other turn. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: Ice cracking, then wind, frost creeping over the black; a whisper like breath on a window | "Cold."

scene.rise: Snow begins to fall on the battlefield. [Name] rises out of a block of ice.

moments.name: Eclipse
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: it comes back at full HP, night for the battle, Dark and Ghost moves x1.75, evasion +1 (no higher). Cost: accuracy -1. The status ends with the battle. One revival per run, shared with every last stand.
moments.presentation: The moon in the black, a shadow sliding across it; a lullaby sung very slowly | "The sun went down on you."

lines: "Close your eyes. I'll do the rest."
scene.rise: The battlefield returns at night. [Name]'s rings, eyes and markings glow.

moments.name: Not From Here
moments.effectText: It is looking at a place that isn't here. (A stop opens: sit with it, or leave it be.)
moments.presentation: It looks up at the sky | [Name] is looking at a place that isn't here.

moments.name: Sibling Rivalry
moments.effectText: Two or more Eeveelutions in the party: each gets +10% to its best stat for the battle. (Limited: the family photo for all nine is not built yet.)
moments.presentation: They argue for a second, then turn to the opponent together | [Name] and its siblings argue, then face the foe as one.

moments.name: Any Road
moments.effectText: Eevee is looking at the stones in your bag. (A stop opens: let it choose its road, or not yet.)
moments.presentation: It noses at your bag | Eevee is looking at the stones in your bag.

moments.name: The Three Skies
moments.effectText: Two or more legendary birds: each bird brings its own sky for one turn when it comes out (Articuno hail, Zapdos storm, Moltres sun).
moments.presentation: The weather flickers between hail, storm and heat | The sky remembers [Name].

moments.name: The Three Skies

moments.presentation: A ring of steel | [Name] steps forward. They fight together.

moments.presentation: Time slows | [Name] moves between the seconds.

moments.name: The Order of Things

moments.presentation: The shadows lengthen | [Name] is not gone. Not from here.
